title: AI-Driven Interactive Platform for Cardano Smart Contracts

ms.promise:

ms.promise:
This milestone focuses on the creation and initial development of two major components: the core AI model and the platform's user interface (UI). Specifically, we will produce:
・A trained AI model capable of interpreting and explaining Cardano smart contracts.
・The initial version of the interactive user interface for the platform, incorporating basic features for query handling and visual representations of smart contracts.
ms.criteria:
・A working prototype of the AI model that accurately interprets and explains Cardano smart contracts, focusing on smart contracts written in Opshin.
・An initial version of the platform's UI that supports basic interaction capabilities, allowing users to query and visually interact with the information provided by the AI model.
・An open-source GitHub repository containing all of the code, including documentation and instructions on how to use the code
ms.report:
Fifth Milestone submission:
Thank you for the clarifications!
We initially reached out to the Catalyst team for feedback on the current situation but continued developing our interface in the meantime. While we have not yet received a response from the Catalyst team, we have now finished integrating an additional visualization feature: interactive execution flow diagrams.
To achieve this, we use a model to analyze the contract's code and generate its execution flow. The result is then rendered as an interactive diagram, enabling users to visually explore and understand how the code executes.
We hope this enhancement meets all requirements, as execution flow diagrams provide a clear visual representation of contract mechanisms and improve code comprehension.
The updated code is available here: https://github.com/unboundedmarket/ai-sc-explainer-interface
The following video shows an example of the code visualizations, including the execution flow diagram and the syntax trees:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1D-YOy-CSP_ww93-QntigHC1O8sCXjr0v/view?usp=sharing
Fourth Milestone submission:
Thank you for the quick feedback! While we understand your perspective, we would like to explain our choice for the visualization:
We chose to visualize the syntax trees because generating diagrams or flowcharts using our fine-tuned language model has proven suboptimal. We communicated this when submitting the PoA for the second time. At this point, we also suggested extracting the visualization directly from the code, instead. We then implemented this approach based on the feedback requiring visualizations of the code.
We truly value the feedback and have iterated multiple times to refine and improve the interface. This has been a significant effort, as the milestone involves numerous components. We believe we have provided all the necessary evidence for this specific milestone:
Model:
・Video showing the capability to explain smart contracts: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QIzqS9q6Uf
